svg.title: ship-ocean-liner: navigation lights under the nav-wright#36 part 2 default
svg.desc: Side view of the Kenney liner mesh at a length of 30 m, bow to the right. Two masts, one at each end of the superstructure, stand highest; the mast band (the top 5% of the hull's height) covers only their tops. The forward masthead light sits at the forward mast's outer edge at 12.64 m and the after masthead light at the after mast's outer edge at 13.86 m.
svg.text: ship-ocean-liner: the lights under the #36 part 2 default
Same two edges, but the masthead height comes from the middle of the band (98% of the hull's height) rather than its highest point.
Kenney Watercraft Kit (CC0), ship-ocean-liner.glb, side view, bow to the right. Orange: the mast band, the top 5% of the hull's height (MAST_BAND 0.95).
mast.aftX to mast.foreX: 0.74 of the length (hullMeshCheck wants under 0.35)
5 m, at a length of 30 m; the mesh is 0.42 as tall as it is long
